items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: Sonny Boy Williamson was there. And he would say, “the blues is where the words are and that’s the form of the blues.”

ctx.x: He had like some Chicago guys and then some from the south. And even in our club they were fighting over whether the blues got 12 bars or not. Sonny Boy Williamson was there. And he would say, “the blues is where the words are and that’s the form of the blues.” You know? Wherever the words go. It could be 12-1/2 or 11-1/2 or 13 or whatever. You just have to listen to the words. The words were more important. And this is with Charlie a little bit too. Like he writes, he sings, and depending on how he phrases the…
